commands:
Other commands:
• *help*: what you can do here
• *status*: what ran or failed recently
• *approvals*: requests waiting for you
• *invoice* a person and an amount (*invoice Ada 25k for rice*)
• *owes*: who owes you, or *Ada owes 5,000*; *Ada paid 5,000*
• *send* an amount *to* @someone (*send 20k to @bayo*): a payment prepared, to confirm in the app
• *sold* and what (*sold 3 bags of rice 45,000 cash*); *stock* and an item
• *tools*: the business's own tools
Things they saved, by @name (kind), for the saved actions' values and for @name in the other commands: @warehouse (place), @bayo (bank account), @mum (person)
